summary: Party of four climbers (ages mid-50s to 75) got off-route and stuck on the West Face of South Maroon Peak; Crested Butte Mountain Rescue passed the call to Mountain Rescue Aspen due to access issues; Aspen Mountain Rescue performed a helicopter hoist evacuation of all four
location: West Face of South Maroon Peak
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Crested Butte Mountain Rescue Team
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE — CBN article covers CBMRT's "busy July and start to August" 2019; pinned to 2019-07-15 by parent convention (siblings ids 2345-2350 from the same article). No injuries reported in the article. Run 731 CBN chunk.
